properties/operation: Language-server operation: definition, references, implementation, or hover at the supplied source position.
properties/path: Source file path, workspace-relative or absolute; follows the current Workspace Access mode. Requires a configured server for the file's extension.
properties/line: One-based source line number in the current file.
properties/column: One-based Unicode character position within that line.
properties/server: Optional configured language-server name to select explicitly from the user's language-servers.json.
properties/offset: Zero-based result-location index, default 0; returns all locations from that position onward. Hover text remains complete.
